cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是英国广播公司国际频道的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Nick Miles, and at 15:00 GMT on Wednesday, the 12th of August, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是尼克·迈尔斯。格林尼治标准时间8月12日星期三15点，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Israeli settlers continue to trap two Palestinian families in their homes in the occupied West Bank after clashing with the Israeli security forces.
cues.zh: 以色列定居者与以色列安全部队发生冲突后，继续将两个巴勒斯坦家庭困在被占领的约旦河西岸家中。

cues.en: The German cabinet has approved plans to give sweeping new powers to its intelligence services.
cues.zh: 德国内阁已批准计划，赋予情报机构广泛的新权力。

cues.en: A passenger jet billed as China's answer to Boeing and Airbus makes its first international flight.
cues.zh: 一款被称为中国抗衡波音和空客之作的客机完成首次国际航班。

cues.en: And a world record for a hydrogen-powered car.
cues.zh: 以及氢动力汽车创下世界纪录。

cues.en: Absolute thrill.
cues.zh: 真是无比激动。

cues.en: They were aiming for 350 miles an hour. They did such a good job.
cues.zh: 他们的目标是每小时350英里。他们做得太出色了。

cues.en: We've just exceeded 400 miles an hour both ways out on the Bonneville Salt Flats.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚在博纳维尔盐滩完成双向行驶，时速都超过了400英里。

cues.en: We start in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, where for the last four days, two homes in the Palestinian village of Qusra have been surrounded by Israeli settlers.
cues.zh: 我们先从以色列占领的约旦河西岸说起。过去四天里，巴勒斯坦村庄库斯拉的两处住宅一直被以色列定居者包围。

cues.en: They've been stopping the families from getting in or out.
cues.zh: 他们一直阻止这些家庭进出。

cues.en: They've also cut off the power and water to the building.
cues.zh: 他们还切断了楼房的水电供应。

cues.en: This Palestinian resident is one of those trapped there.
cues.zh: 这名巴勒斯坦居民就是被困者之一。

cues.en: I am Qusay Abu Rida from the village of Qusra, south of Nablus.
cues.zh: 我是库赛·阿布·里达，来自纳布卢斯以南的库斯拉村。

cues.en: Four days ago, settlers came to the house and blocked us from leaving.
cues.zh: 四天前，定居者来到这座房子，阻止我们离开。

cues.en: They stopped anyone from coming to the house.
cues.zh: 他们也阻止任何人来到这里。

cues.en: We have been deprived of all necessities.
cues.zh: 我们被剥夺了所有生活必需品。

cues.en: They cut off the electricity and water, and supply of healthcare.
cues.zh: 他们切断了水电，也断绝了医疗服务。

cues.en: There is a family living in a nearby house.
cues.zh: 附近的一座房子里住着一家人。

cues.en: They have two children, aged four and two.
cues.zh: 他们有两个孩子，分别为四岁和两岁。

cues.en: They have also been cut off from the outside world.
cues.zh: 他们也与外界隔绝了。

cues.en: We are unable to leave the house, and our situation is tragic.
cues.zh: 我们无法离开房子，处境十分悲惨。

cues.en: The soldiers arrived at the house, but they did nothing.
cues.zh: 士兵来到这座房子，却什么也没做。

cues.en: We appeal to the humanitarian organizations to help us, and protect us, and provide food and medicine to the families who are besieged by the settlers.
cues.zh: 我们呼吁人道主义组织帮助并保护我们，为遭定居者围困的家庭提供食物和药品。

cues.en: Israeli settlements in the West Bank are illegal under both international and Israeli law.
cues.zh: 根据国际法和以色列法律，以色列在约旦河西岸的定居点均属非法。

cues.en: However, so far, the Israeli security forces haven't been able or willing to break up what is effectively a siege.
cues.zh: 然而到目前为止，以色列安全部队没有能力或不愿解除这场实质上的围困。

cues.en: Doron Meinert is a retired colonel in the Israeli military, the IDF, who's now a member of Looking the Occupation in the Eye.
cues.zh: 多伦·迈纳特是以色列国防军退役上校，现为“直视占领”组织成员。

cues.en: That's a volunteer group opposed to the Israeli occupation. He's also in Qusra.
cues.zh: 这是一个反对以色列占领的志愿者团体。他也在库斯拉。

cues.en: This morning, the commander of the Central Command, which is Brigadier General Avi Bluth,
cues.zh: 今天早上，中央司令部司令阿维·布卢特准将到过那里，

cues.en: have been there and promised the Palestinian resident that he is going to solve the problem.
cues.zh: 并向这名巴勒斯坦居民承诺会解决问题。

cues.en: And he didn't do it yet. You know, maybe, maybe he will do it in the close future.
cues.zh: 但他还没有做到。你知道，也许，也许他不久后会做到。

cues.en: But yet he didn't succeed to do it, and it's very embarrassing, I think, for him and for the IDF.
cues.zh: 但他尚未成功做到。我认为，这对他和以色列国防军来说都非常难堪。

cues.en: Our correspondent Jon Donnison is the first international journalist to get to the village of Qusra. He told me what's been happening there.
cues.zh: 本台记者乔恩·唐尼森是首位抵达库斯拉村的国际记者。他向我介绍了当地的情况。

cues.en: Well, we're just on the edge of the village of Qusra in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, and I'm looking up at these four houses which are on the opposite hillside.
cues.zh: 我们就在以色列占领的约旦河西岸库斯拉村边缘，我正望着对面山坡上的这四座房屋。

cues.en: We're a distance of what may be half a mile or so, and I can make out just to the left of those houses, there are still what looks to be about ten settlers there.
cues.zh: 我们相距大约半英里。我能辨认出那些房屋左侧似乎仍有大约十名定居者。

cues.en: And I can see where they've established some sort of roadblock just a few hundred meters down the line.
cues.zh: 我还能看到他们在几百米外设置了某种路障。

cues.en: Now, these four properties have been under siege by settlers since Sunday.
cues.zh: 这四处房产自星期日以来一直遭定居者围困。

cues.en: At some points, the water and electricity has been cut off.
cues.zh: 期间水电一度被切断。

cues.en: Now, we have spoken to one of the families who are under siege, and they said that this morning the Israeli army came and they dismantled some of the settler tents.
cues.zh: 我们采访了一个遭围困的家庭。他们说，今天早上以色列军队到场，拆除了一些定居者的帐篷。

cues.en: But as soon as the army moved on, the settlers came back.
cues.zh: 但军队一离开，定居者就回来了。

cues.en: And this is, you know, a new tactic by the settlers.
cues.zh: 而这，你知道，是定居者采用的一种新策略。

cues.en: There's been a huge surge in settler violence against Palestinians in recent years.
cues.zh: 近年来，定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力事件大幅增加。

cues.en: The UN, I think, says there are on average around about six attacks on Palestinian communities taking place every day this year.
cues.zh: 我记得联合国称，今年平均每天约有六起针对巴勒斯坦社区的袭击。

cues.en: That involves violence; six Palestinians have been killed, hundreds injured.
cues.zh: 其中包括暴力行为；六名巴勒斯坦人丧生，数百人受伤。

cues.en: It involves burning property, burning farmland.
cues.zh: 还包括焚烧房产和农田。

cues.en: But this is different. What they're doing, in effect, is to try and starve these Palestinian families out with the view to take those houses over.
cues.zh: 但这次不同。他们实际上企图迫使这些巴勒斯坦家庭断粮离开，以便占据这些房屋。

cues.en: Now, Jon, can we expect the military to go back there and confront these settlers more robustly, perhaps?
cues.zh: 那么，乔恩，我们能否期待军方返回那里，以更强硬的方式对付这些定居者？

cues.en: Perhaps. You know, we have had strong words of condemnation from senior leaders within the Israeli military.
cues.zh: 也许。你知道，以色列军方高级领导人已经发表了措辞强烈的谴责。

cues.en: But as we've seen throughout this past few days, you know, there is a bit of an ambiguity about some of the role of the soldiers.
cues.zh: 但正如过去几天所见，你知道，士兵在其中扮演的某些角色有些模糊。

cues.en: So, at the weekend, we saw video footage showing some of the soldiers praying with the settlers.
cues.zh: 周末我们看到一段视频，显示一些士兵与定居者一同祈祷。

cues.en: Some of the soldiers are settlers themselves, so the army may well come back.
cues.zh: 一些士兵本身就是定居者，因此军队很可能会回来。

cues.en: But the accusation from human rights groups and from Palestinian communities is that the Israeli military allows settlers to act with impunity,
cues.zh: 但人权团体和巴勒斯坦社区指控，以色列军方纵容定居者逍遥法外，

cues.en: with the backing of senior figures within Prime Minister Netanyahu's cabinet who support the settler actions.
cues.zh: 而支持这些定居者行动的内塔尼亚胡总理内阁高层人士在为他们撑腰。

cues.en: And the accusation is that they don't do enough and that there are very rarely prosecutions for settler violence.
cues.zh: 相关指控称，军方行动不足，而且定居者暴力事件极少受到起诉。

cues.en: Nevertheless, there is increasing international scrutiny on what's going on in parts of the West Bank.
cues.zh: 尽管如此，约旦河西岸部分地区的事态正受到越来越多的国际关注。

cues.en: To what extent will that play into the pressure that the government brings to bear on what's happening?
cues.zh: 这会在多大程度上促使政府对当前事态施加压力？

cues.en: Well, look, there's been pressure and condemnation from the international community for a long time, you know, before the last few years, since the war in Gaza started,
cues.zh: 你看，国际社会长期以来一直施压和谴责；你知道，在过去几年、加沙战争开始之前就已如此，

cues.en: which is when we really saw an escalation in settler violence. And that pressure hasn't really worked.
cues.zh: 而加沙战争开始后，定居者暴力才真正升级。这些压力并没有真正奏效。

cues.en: We have heard Prime Minister Netanyahu in the past and other senior politicians within his government strongly condemning the violence by settlers.
cues.zh: 过去，我们听到内塔尼亚胡总理及其政府中的其他高级政治人物强烈谴责定居者暴力。

cues.en: But as I say, prosecutions are rare, and within Prime Minister Netanyahu's own cabinet,
cues.zh: 但正如我所说，起诉非常罕见；在内塔尼亚胡总理自己的内阁中，

cues.en: he has right-wing ministers who not only don't condemn what the settlers are doing, they actively are accused of encouraging it and inciting such violence.
cues.zh: 有些右翼部长不仅不谴责定居者的行为，还被指积极鼓励并煽动此类暴力。

cues.en: Jon Donnison speaking to me from a windy hillside near the village of Qusra.
cues.zh: 乔恩·唐尼森在库斯拉村附近一处风大的山坡上向我报道。

cues.en: In Germany, the government has decided to give the intelligence services far more power.
cues.zh: 德国政府已决定赋予情报机构大得多的权力。

cues.en: Ministers say this is because of rising security threats,
cues.zh: 部长们称这是由于安全威胁日益上升，

cues.en: but opposition parties and civil liberties groups fear that it will lead to comprehensive surveillance of the whole population.
cues.zh: 但反对党和公民自由团体担心，这将导致对全体人口的全面监控。

cues.en: They're particularly worried about this because of Germany's history.
cues.zh: 鉴于德国的历史，他们对此尤其担忧。

cues.en: Parliament will still have to approve the reform.
cues.zh: 这项改革仍须获得议会批准。

cues.en: Our correspondent in Berlin, Jessica Parker, told James Menendez what new powers the agencies are to get.
cues.zh: 本台驻柏林记者杰茜卡·帕克向詹姆斯·梅嫩德斯介绍了这些机构将获得哪些新权力。

cues.en: What they're looking at cuts across the domestic and foreign intelligence services.
cues.zh: 他们考虑的措施横跨国内和对外情报机构。

cues.en: So, to give you a flavour of what those services may be able to do in future?this still all needs to go before lawmakers in the autumn?
cues.zh: 为了让你大致了解这些机构未来可能获准做什么——这一切仍须在秋季提交立法者审议——

cues.en: they could be able to manipulate, disrupt, hack the IT infrastructure of a foreign power if Germany was undergoing a cyber or disinformation attack.
cues.zh: 如果德国遭受网络攻击或虚假信息攻击，他们可能获准操纵、破坏或入侵外国势力的信息技术基础设施。

cues.en: They could, agents, potentially be able to break into a residence and replace explosives with something that's harmless as part of counter-intelligence operations.
cues.zh: 在反情报行动中，特工还可能获准闯入住所，将爆炸物替换为无害物品。

cues.en: And in the sort of data-retention sphere, where Germany has had for a long time very strict privacy rules,
cues.zh: 而在数据保留领域，德国长期实行非常严格的隐私规定，

cues.en: they'll loosen those rules, so there'll be longer data-retention periods, greater powers in terms of surveillance as well via telecommunications.
cues.zh: 这些规定将会放宽，数据保留期限会延长，通过电信手段开展监控的权力也会扩大。

cues.en: So that's a flavour of what they'll be able to do. And some people listening might be thinking, weren't they able, under certain rules and thresholds, able to do this anyway?
cues.zh: 这大致就是他们未来能够做的事情。一些听众可能会想：在满足某些规则和门槛的情况下，他们原本不就能这样做吗？

cues.en: Well, not really. In Germany, there have been very strict guardrails and constraints on the intelligence services.
cues.zh: 其实并非如此。在德国，情报机构一直受到非常严格的防护规定和限制。

cues.en: as a legacy of what Germans experienced at the hands of Nazi spies and also the Stasi in East Germany.
cues.zh: 这是德国人曾遭纳粹特务以及东德史塔西迫害所留下的历史遗产。

cues.en: So this is about loosening restrictions that really are very historically embedded in Germany here.
cues.zh: 所以，这项改革是在放宽那些深深植根于德国历史的限制。

cues.en: And of course, the plans certainly have their critics, people who think that there's overreach going on.
cues.zh: 当然，这些计划也确实受到批评；有人认为其中存在权力越界。

cues.en: Tell us, though, about the context, because clearly that's what's driving this.
cues.zh: 不过请介绍一下背景，因为显然正是这种背景在推动改革。

cues.en: Is this a response to the threat from Russia, or is there more to it too?
cues.zh: 这是对俄罗斯威胁的回应，还是也有其他原因？

cues.en: I think it's absolutely a response to the threat from Russia.
cues.zh: 我认为这绝对是对俄罗斯威胁的回应。

cues.en: I think you could absolutely see this, or it's beginning to be seen, as part of that Zeitenwende that was announced in the wake of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine,
cues.zh: 我认为完全可以把这视为——或者说它正开始被视为——俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后宣布的那场“时代转折”的一部分，

cues.en: where Germany basically acknowledged that for a long time it had underinvested in its military and that it needed to be more robust in terms of security and intelligence.
cues.zh: 当时德国基本承认，长期以来对军队投入不足，需要在安全和情报方面变得更强有力。

cues.en: And its intelligence agencies are absolutely now becoming part of that Zeitenwende.
cues.zh: 如今，德国的情报机构无疑也正成为这场“时代转折”的一部分。

cues.en: So I think that's absolutely important context here.
cues.zh: 因此，我认为这是非常重要的背景。

cues.en: And Germany's government says that it is the target of?Germany is the target of daily hybrid attacks, hybrid warfare attacks,
cues.zh: 德国政府表示，它是——德国每天都在遭受混合攻击、混合战争攻击，

cues.en: whether that might be disinformation, whether that might be cyber attacks, whether that might even be sabotage as well.
cues.zh: 无论是虚假信息、网络攻击，甚至还可能包括破坏活动。

cues.en: So it's saying it has to get more robust in the face of hostile actors. But it will apply in the domestic sphere as well.
cues.zh: 因此政府称，面对敌对行为者必须更加强硬。但这些权力也会适用于国内领域。

cues.en: There's some various divisions of powers that are a bit complicated to go into between the domestic and the foreign intelligence services.
cues.zh: 国内和对外情报机构之间存在多种权力划分，解释起来有些复杂。

cues.en: But I think that absolutely is the overall context.
cues.zh: 但我认为，这无疑就是总体背景。

cues.en: And this sense, traditionally Germany's intelligence services have been described as somewhat vegetarian, whilst other Western allies have been more carnivorous.
cues.zh: 从这个意义上说，德国情报机构传统上被形容为有些“素食主义”，而其他西方盟友则更“食肉”。

cues.en: And they're trying to bring them a bit more up to the standard of other Western agencies,
cues.zh: 他们正试图让德国情报机构更接近其他西方机构的标准，

cues.en: although they are being clear that they won't be sanctioning the use of, for example, lethal force.
cues.zh: 不过他们明确表示，不会批准使用致命武力等手段。

cues.en: Jessica Parker in Berlin.
cues.zh: 杰茜卡·帕克在柏林报道。

cues.en: In recent years, China has been taking huge chunks of the global market in green technology and electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 近年来，中国在绿色技术和电动汽车全球市场中占据了巨大份额。

cues.en: It's also been racing ahead in the development of AI.
cues.zh: 中国在人工智能发展方面也在快速推进。

cues.en: So far, though, it's lagged behind in aircraft production.
cues.zh: 不过到目前为止，中国在飞机制造方面仍然落后。

cues.en: But now, a new jet being built as China's answer to large Boeing or Airbus passenger planes has made its first international commercial flight.
cues.zh: 但现在，一款被视为中国对标波音和空客大型客机的新型喷气式飞机完成了首次国际商业飞行。

cues.en: Our China correspondent, Stephen McDonnell, told me more.
cues.zh: 本台驻中国记者斯蒂芬·麦克唐奈作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: That's the first international link using these homegrown, if I can put it that way, commercial passenger jets made in China, the COMAC C919.
cues.zh: 这是首条使用这种国产——如果可以这么说——中国制造商用客机COMAC C919的国际航线。

cues.en: So from today, this will be a regular connection between Beijing and Ulaanbaatar, the capital of Mongolia.
cues.zh: 从今天起，它将成为北京与蒙古国首都乌兰巴托之间的定期航线。

cues.en: And I guess that they're hoping that eventually these planes will challenge the dominance of Boeing and Airbus.
cues.zh: 我想他们希望这些飞机最终能够挑战波音和空客的主导地位。

cues.en: I mean, to give you an idea of the size of the planes, I mean, we're talking about something similar to the size of a Boeing 737.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，为了让你了解飞机的大小，它的尺寸大致与波音737相当。

cues.en: So these are large commercial aircraft.
cues.zh: 所以，这些是大型商用飞机。

cues.en: But I think many aviation analysts would say it's going to take a while to really challenge this significant international market,
cues.zh: 但我想，许多航空分析人士会说，要真正挑战这个重要的国际市场还需要一段时间，

cues.en: because these large Western companies are so entrenched and, I guess, trusted in a way too.
cues.zh: 因为这些西方大型企业根基深厚，而且在某种程度上也受到信任。

cues.en: You know, this is something that it's going to take a while for people to say, ‘Well, can we really—’
cues.zh: 你知道，人们还需要一段时间才会开始问：“嗯，我们真的能——”

cues.en: I don't know, do we trust you?
cues.zh: 我不知道，我们能信任你们吗？

cues.en: Are these planes safe?
cues.zh: 这些飞机安全吗？

cues.en: Are they going to be okay?’
cues.zh: 它们会不会出问题？”

cues.en: But you mentioned China's massive inroads into other areas of technology, so why not commercial aircraft?
cues.zh: 但你提到中国在其他技术领域取得了巨大进展，那么商用飞机为什么不行呢？

cues.en: And how significant is this for Beijing, do you think, psychologically? Is it good for national pride, do you think?
cues.zh: 你认为这对北京在心理层面有多重要？它是否有助于提升民族自豪感？

cues.en: Yeah, absolutely.
cues.zh: 是的，当然。

cues.en: You put it up there with the space programme in China that, not so long ago, hardly existed.
cues.zh: 可以把它与中国的太空计划相提并论；就在不久前，这项计划还几乎不存在。

cues.en: Now China has its own space station.
cues.zh: 现在中国拥有了自己的空间站。

cues.en: You look—you compare them to other countries.
cues.zh: 你看，把中国与其他国家比较一下。

cues.en: There's, like, an international space station with all these other countries combining.
cues.zh: 比如国际空间站，是由许多国家联合建设的。

cues.en: China's got its own one, and they're regularly putting people up there.
cues.zh: 而中国有自己的空间站，并定期把人员送上去。

cues.en: It was said by the government not so long ago: if we're going to be taken seriously, we need to be making commercial jets.
cues.zh: 不久前，政府曾表示：如果我们想得到认真对待，就必须制造商用喷气式飞机。

cues.en: And that's exactly what China's doing now.
cues.zh: 而这正是中国现在所做的。

cues.en: By the way, these have been tested already domestically.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这些飞机已经在国内经过了测试。

cues.en: So for a few years now, the COMAC C919s have been running within China.
cues.zh: 过去几年，COMAC C919一直在中国国内运营。

cues.en: But just, you know, the symbolism of it now being international, even if it's only one route, even if it's only to a neighbouring country,
cues.zh: 但你知道，如今它走向国际所具有的象征意义——哪怕只有一条航线，哪怕只是飞往邻国——

cues.en: the hope is that they'd start to push out the use of these planes much further afield.
cues.zh: 人们希望这会推动这些飞机在更远的地区得到使用。

cues.en: Stephen McDonnell in Beijing.
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬·麦克唐奈在北京报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast: as a film about the early career of Anthony Bourdain hits cinemas,
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有：随着一部讲述安东尼·波登早期事业的电影上映，

cues.en: we hear what was so unique about this American chef and writer.
cues.zh: 我们将了解这位美国厨师兼作家的独特之处。

cues.en: There was something very kinetic and bullshitty about the way he wrote about that world,
cues.zh: 他描写那个世界的方式充满动感，也带着一种胡说八道的劲头，

cues.en: and he became the appointed spokesperson for a whole particular culture, and that was something we didn't feel we'd heard before.
cues.zh: 他成了某种特定文化的指定代言人，而这种声音是我们以前未曾听到的。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: At the end of July, an estimated 72,000 migrants swam or climbed around the border fence between Morocco and Ceuta,
cues.zh: 7月底，估计有7.2万名移民游泳或攀爬绕过摩洛哥与休达之间的边境围栏；

cues.en: a Spanish enclave on Morocco's Mediterranean coast, in an attempt to reach Europe.
cues.zh: 休达是位于摩洛哥地中海沿岸的西班牙飞地，他们试图由此进入欧洲。

cues.en: Around 100 people died.
cues.zh: 约有100人死亡。

cues.en: Social media played a key role in the crisis, with many posts spreading misinformation.
cues.zh: 社交媒体在这场危机中发挥了关键作用，许多帖子传播了虚假信息。

cues.en: Well, now the BBC has found that these social media accounts are again posting messages to hundreds of thousands of followers,
cues.zh: 现在BBC发现，这些社交媒体账号再次向数十万关注者发布消息，

cues.en: encouraging them to attempt another crossing in the coming days.
cues.zh: 鼓励他们在未来几天再次尝试越境。

cues.en: The BBC's global population correspondent, Stephanie Hegarty, has been investigating.
cues.zh: BBC全球人口事务记者斯蒂芬妮·赫加蒂对此展开了调查。

cues.en: We looked at this ecosystem that has existed for months, maybe years in some cases, where these Facebook groups and Instagram accounts
cues.zh: 我们研究了这个已经存在数月、某些情况下甚至数年的生态系统；这些Facebook群组和Instagram账号，

cues.en: share information about crossing the border, tips and different bits of information to help people cross the border illegally.
cues.zh: 会分享越境信息、技巧和各种内容，帮助人们非法越过边境。

cues.en: And these are the groups in which messages about the border in late July started to spread—
cues.zh: 正是在这些群组中，关于7月底边境的消息开始传播——

cues.en: misinformation, things that were completely untrue, like the fact that the border was open.
cues.zh: 其中包括完全不实的信息，例如边境已经开放。

cues.en: So these are the same groups and accounts that were sharing information that caused this first surge of 72,000 people across the border.
cues.zh: 正是这些群组和账号传播的信息，引发了第一波7.2万人越境。

cues.en: And, of course, we know that at least 100 of those people died.
cues.zh: 当然，我们知道其中至少有100人死亡。

cues.en: Now, they continued after that first crossing in late July, and what we saw in the past couple of weeks is that
cues.zh: 7月底的首次越境事件之后，这些账号仍在继续活动；过去几周我们看到，

cues.en: new messages are being shared encouraging people to attempt another crossing, and they're being shared widely across these groups.
cues.zh: 鼓励人们再次越境的新消息正在传播，并在这些群组中被广泛转发。

cues.en: We looked at dozens of groups and found hundreds of these posts.
cues.zh: 我们查看了数十个群组，发现了数百条此类帖子。

cues.en: So they're sharing information. First of all, they're just showing pictures of the border with the date that they're encouraging people to make this second attempt at crossing.
cues.zh: 他们正在分享信息。首先，他们展示边境照片，并附上鼓励人们第二次尝试越境的日期。

cues.en: We also found people sharing information about equipment they might use, like wetsuits, or, we saw in one case,
cues.zh: 我们还发现有人分享可能使用的装备，例如潜水服；有一次我们还看到，

cues.en: a sea scooter, which is a kind of propeller machine that would help you swim faster around the coast.
cues.zh: 一种水下推进器，也就是能帮助人在沿岸水域游得更快的螺旋桨装置。

cues.en: When we alerted Meta, the owners of Facebook and Instagram, about these posts, and we sent a list of some of the posts we had seen,
cues.zh: 当我们把这些帖子告知Facebook和Instagram的母公司Meta，并发送了一份所见帖子的清单后，

cues.en: all of the ones that we sent to them, two hours later, had been deleted, or we couldn't see them anymore.
cues.zh: 两小时后，我们发给他们的所有帖子都被删除了，或者我们已经无法再看到。

cues.en: Is it possible to tell who is behind these accounts?
cues.zh: 能否判断这些账号背后是什么人？

cues.en: What we saw from the accounts we looked at is it does seem to be a kind of a very decentralised group of people.
cues.zh: 从我们查看的账号来看，背后似乎是一群组织非常分散的人。

cues.en: Many of the accounts, when we looked back as far as we could, seemed to be set up by ordinary people.
cues.zh: 我们尽可能追溯这些账号后发现，其中许多似乎是普通人建立的。

cues.en: Some of them were small, some of them were huge, some had over 100,000 members, some were smaller.
cues.zh: 有些规模很小，有些非常庞大；有些成员超过10万，也有些规模较小。

cues.en: We couldn't see any evidence that this was organised in any way by, say, smugglers.
cues.zh: 我们没有看到任何证据表明，这是由蛇头之类的人以某种方式组织的。

cues.en: It did seem to be ordinary people, and from what we saw of what happened in July, it did seem
cues.zh: 看起来确实是普通人在参与；从我们看到的7月事件来看，这似乎，

cues.en: to be a kind of organic spread of misinformation across this ecosystem of groups and accounts that already existed.
cues.zh: 是虚假信息在既有群组和账号生态中自发扩散的结果。

cues.en: And is there any sort of self-reflection in these groups?
cues.zh: 这些群组中有没有出现某种反思？

cues.en: I mean, as you say, at least 100 people are thought to have died.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，正如你所说，据信至少有100人死亡。

cues.en: Is there any recognition of the dangers? Because if they're calling for people to take those sorts of risks again,
cues.zh: 他们有没有意识到其中的危险？因为如果他们号召人们再次冒这种风险，

cues.en: there's, of course, the sad possibility that more people die.
cues.zh: 当然，令人悲哀的是，可能会有更多人死亡。

cues.en: There were—I mean, they were also providing a kind of platform where people could share information about those that had gone missing or those that had died.
cues.zh: 确实有——我的意思是，他们也提供了某种平台，让人们分享失踪者或遇难者的信息。

cues.en: But they seemed to be a minority of the posts.
cues.zh: 但这类帖子似乎只占少数。

cues.en: And under some of the calls for another crossing this week, we saw people saying, ‘Don't do this, don't fall for this.
cues.zh: 在一些号召本周再次越境的帖子下，我们看到有人留言：“不要这样做，不要上当。

cues.en: These are lies. This isn't true.’
cues.zh: 这些都是谎言，不是真的。”

cues.en: But again, that did seem to be a minority of what was being posted.
cues.zh: 但同样，这似乎只占所发布内容的少数。

cues.en: Stephanie Hegarty there, speaking to James Copnall.
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·赫加蒂接受詹姆斯·科普纳尔采访。

cues.en: Is Donald Trump the election winner he once was?
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普还像从前那样善于赢得选举吗？

cues.en: Results from Republican primaries on Tuesday suggest that his endorsement still carries significant weight in some places, but not everywhere.
cues.zh: 星期二的共和党初选结果表明，他的背书在一些地方仍很有分量，但并非处处如此。

cues.en: Public enthusiasm for the president more widely has certainly waned.
cues.zh: 从更广泛的范围看，公众对总统的热情确实已经减退。

cues.en: Recent polling placed his approval rating at a historic low of 32%.
cues.zh: 近期民调显示，他的支持率跌至32%的历史低点。

cues.en: Rising petrol prices and inflation more generally are taking their toll,
cues.zh: 汽油价格上涨以及更普遍的通货膨胀正在造成影响，

cues.en: with some polls even showing self-identified MAGA voters have begun to suffer Iran war fatigue.
cues.zh: 一些民调甚至显示，自称MAGA支持者的选民也开始出现伊朗战争疲劳。

cues.en: The BBC's Sheila Flynn has spent the last week speaking to Trump supporters in the Tennessee town of Kingsport
cues.zh: BBC记者希拉·弗林过去一周一直在田纳西州金斯波特镇采访特朗普支持者，

cues.en: to see if the war has eroded support for the president in one of his strongholds.
cues.zh: 以了解这场战争是否削弱了总统在这一基本盘的支持。

cues.en: Support for President Trump's Make America Great Again platform is overwhelming in this
cues.zh: 在这座山城里，对特朗普总统“让美国再次伟大”政治纲领的支持占压倒性优势。

cues.en: mountain town, which voted for Trump by comfortable margins in all three of his elections.
cues.zh: 特朗普参加的三次选举中，这里都以明显优势把票投给了他。

cues.en: No one I speak to here is happy about inflation, but few lay the blame at the president's feet.
cues.zh: 我在这里采访的人没有谁对通胀感到满意，但很少有人把责任归咎于总统。

cues.en: I think they're doing a great job, I mean, with what he can control.
cues.zh: 我觉得他们干得很好，我是说，在他能控制的事情上。

cues.en: Parked on his Harley-Davidson outside a local cafe, I meet 53-year-old Daniel Overstreet.
cues.zh: 在当地一家咖啡馆外，我见到了骑着哈雷摩托车的53岁男子丹尼尔·奥弗斯特里特。

cues.en: Whether it was the Iran war or anything else, we're not going to control those gas prices.
cues.zh: 不管是伊朗战争还是其他什么事，我们都控制不了那些汽油价格。

cues.en: And people can complain and fuss. It's not going to change that.
cues.zh: 人们可以抱怨、发牢骚，但那也改变不了什么。

cues.en: Also stopping for his breakfast is David Carter, a bearded veteran who plays Santa Claus at Christmastime.
cues.zh: 来这里吃早餐的还有戴维·卡特，这位留着胡子的退伍军人会在圣诞节扮演圣诞老人。

cues.en: He backs the president's involvement in the Middle East.
cues.zh: 他支持总统介入中东事务。

cues.en: You've seen it in history.
cues.zh: 历史上已经有过这样的事。

cues.en: The reason we go over there and we keep everything under control there is we don't have it on our front doorstep.
cues.zh: 我们之所以去那里、把局势控制在那里，就是为了不让问题来到自家门前。

cues.en: Veterans account for around 10% of the region's population.
cues.zh: 退伍军人约占这一地区人口的10%。

cues.en: The town is also home to the Holston Army Ammunition Plant,
cues.zh: 霍尔斯顿陆军弹药厂也坐落在这座小城，

cues.en: which churns out explosives used in Patriot missiles and other heavy weaponry for US military stockpiles.
cues.zh: 该厂生产用于“爱国者”导弹及其他重型武器的炸药，供美国军方储备。

cues.en: David says that while he and many others in the town still back the president's goals overall,
cues.zh: 戴维说，尽管他和镇上许多人总体上仍支持总统的目标，

cues.en: the war has certainly caused some frustration amongst the supporters.
cues.zh: 这场战争确实让一些支持者感到不满。

cues.en: Trump said 'America First,' and he's not put America first. He's put the war overseas first.
cues.zh: 特朗普说“美国优先”，可他没有把美国放在第一位，而是把海外战争放在了第一位。

cues.en: In addition to the munitions plant, the city is home to a number of major factories,
cues.zh: 除了弹药厂，这座城市还有多家大型工厂，

cues.en: employers Trump came to office promising to defend.
cues.zh: 这些正是特朗普上台时承诺要保护的雇主。

cues.en: 65-year-old Pam Robinson spent 20 years working at the local chemical plant.
cues.zh: 65岁的帕姆·罗宾逊曾在当地化工厂工作20年。

cues.en: While she also fears the prospect of a nuclear Iran, she does think
cues.zh: 虽然她也担心伊朗拥核的前景，但她确实认为，

cues.en: patience for the war, even here in Kingsport, has its limits.
cues.zh: 即使在金斯波特，人们对战争的耐心也有极限。

cues.en: If people aren't getting killed, I think people will tolerate it a little bit longer.
cues.zh: 只要没有人丧生，我想大家还会再容忍一阵子。

cues.en: But they're going to say soon, 'You need to wrap this up. Something needs to be done. Something needs to be decided.'
cues.zh: 但他们很快就会说：“你得把这事结束掉。必须采取行动，必须作出决定。”

cues.en: Despite a few misgivings, none of the Trump voters I spoke to brought up the war unprompted.
cues.zh: 尽管存在一些顾虑，但我采访的特朗普选民中，没有人主动提起这场战争。

cues.en: This is deep Bible Belt America, a moniker that many here embrace proudly.
cues.zh: 这里是美国“圣经地带”的腹地，当地许多人都自豪地接受这一称谓。

cues.en: Christianity is often the primary driver of their voting intention. Dave and Pam again.
cues.zh: 基督教信仰往往是影响他们投票意向的首要因素。下面再次听听戴维和帕姆。

cues.en: This country strayed away from God compared to what it used to be.
cues.zh: 与过去相比，这个国家已经背离了上帝。

cues.en: The first question I ask: 'Do you believe in abortion?'
cues.zh: 我问的第一个问题是：“你支持堕胎吗？”

cues.en: And usually, if I get that answer, I know pretty well where I need to go on the rest of it.
cues.zh: 通常只要知道这个答案，我就很清楚其他问题该怎么选了。

cues.en: Even if his national support is slipping, there's little to indicate that the Republican core conservative base here looks likely to break faith with President Trump.
cues.zh: 即使特朗普的全国支持率正在下滑，也几乎没有迹象表明这里的共和党核心保守派基本盘会背弃他。

cues.en: That report by Sheila Flynn.
cues.zh: 以上是希拉·弗林的报道。

cues.en: Breaking land speed records is an age-old obsession.
cues.zh: 打破陆地速度纪录是一项由来已久的执念。

cues.en: The vehicles that do it these days look more like horizontal rockets than cars.
cues.zh: 如今用来挑战纪录的车辆，看起来更像横卧的火箭而不是汽车。

cues.en: But there was something groundbreaking about the one that's just gone more than 654 kilometers an hour
cues.zh: 不过，这辆车刚刚跑出了超过每小时654公里的速度，确有一项开创性突破，

cues.en: on the blindingly bright plain known as the Bonneville Salt Flats in the US state of Utah.
cues.zh: 地点是在美国犹他州耀眼的邦纳维尔盐滩。

cues.en: It was a hydrogen-powered car breaking the record for that type of vehicle.
cues.zh: 这是一辆氢动力汽车，打破了此类车辆的速度纪录。

cues.en: The only emissions: a trickle of water vapor from the exhaust pipe.
cues.zh: 它唯一的排放物，是从排气管流出的一点水蒸气。

cues.en: The intrepid driver was retired British Air Force pilot Andy Green.
cues.zh: 这位勇敢的车手是退役英国空军飞行员安迪·格林。

cues.en: He spoke to James Copnall straight after he got out of the car.
cues.zh: 他一下车便接受了詹姆斯·科普纳尔的采访。

cues.en: Absolute thrill. They were aiming for 350 miles an hour. They did such a good job.
cues.zh: 真是无比激动。他们的目标是每小时350英里，工作完成得太出色了。

cues.en: We've just exceeded 400 miles an hour both ways out on the Bonneville Salt Flats.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚在邦纳维尔盐滩的双向行驶中都超过了每小时400英里。

cues.en: An exceptional team effort, and it's been brilliant to work with a genuinely world-class team of people.
cues.zh: 这是非凡的团队成果，能与一支真正世界级的团队合作，实在太棒了。

cues.en: And to watch them do in five or six days on the Bonneville Salt Flats
cues.zh: 看着他们在邦纳维尔盐滩用五六天时间，

cues.en: what would normally take a high-speed racing team five or six years to achieve has just been extraordinary.
cues.zh: 完成高速赛车团队通常需要五六年才能做到的事，实在不同凡响。

cues.en: When you are traveling 400 miles an hour, 650 kilometers an hour or so,
cues.zh: 当你以每小时400英里、也就是大约650公里的速度行驶时，

cues.en: presumably there's not much time to enjoy the stark beauty of the salt flats.
cues.zh: 想必没有多少时间欣赏盐滩冷峻的美景。

cues.en: Well, you know, strapping into the car and starting the engines,
cues.zh: 嗯，你知道，当我系好安全带、启动发动机时，

cues.en: I can actually look down the—the 12-mile-long racetrack, best racing surface in the world.
cues.zh: 我可以望向那条——那条12英里长的赛道，它是世界上最好的赛道表面。

cues.en: That's, you know, the reason that it's the spiritual home of the land speed record.
cues.zh: 你知道，这就是它被称为陆地速度纪录圣地的原因。

cues.en: We're actually sitting out on the salt flats right now, looking into the distance.
cues.zh: 我们此刻就坐在盐滩上，眺望远方。

cues.en: And it is quite literally somewhere you can see the curvature of the Earth.
cues.zh: 在这里，你真的可以看到地球的弧度。

cues.en: It's a smooth, hard, consistent surface in excess of 10 miles long.
cues.zh: 这里有一片超过10英里长、平滑、坚硬而均匀的表面。

cues.en: You can take cars up to very high speed and have the distance to slow them down safely again.
cues.zh: 你可以把汽车开到极高速度，同时又有足够距离让它安全减速。

cues.en: And there's also the Bonneville Salt Flats itself.
cues.zh: 此外，还有邦纳维尔盐滩本身。

cues.en: Now, over the decades, there's been a lot of mining of minerals in the salt flats, and they are getting thinner and thinner.
cues.zh: 几十年来，盐滩经历了大量矿物开采，盐层正变得越来越薄。

cues.en: So there's a marvelous organization called Save the Salt, who have spent decades lobbying local and national government to encourage
cues.zh: 因此，有一个很棒的组织叫“拯救盐滩”，几十年来一直游说地方和中央政府，敦促，

cues.en: the mining companies—all they need to do is, all the spoil they take off, pump it back onto Bonneville.
cues.zh: 采矿公司把挖出的废料重新泵回邦纳维尔——他们只需要这样做。

cues.en: And that has been happening intermittently over the last few years.
cues.zh: 过去几年里，这项工作一直断断续续地进行。

cues.en: There's another push for them now to restore the most amazing racetrack on Earth back
cues.zh: 如今又有人推动他们把这条地球上最令人惊叹的赛道，

cues.en: to its full former glory and to replace the salt that's been mined out of it.
cues.zh: 完全恢复往日风貌，并补回被开采走的盐。

cues.en: So whether you've got a 50cc motorcycle or a 10-liter hydrogen-powered supercar like the JCB Hydromax, this is the place to come.
cues.zh: 所以，无论你骑的是50cc摩托车，还是像JCB Hydromax这样搭载10升发动机的氢动力超级跑车，这里都是必来之地。

cues.en: I'm fascinated by your own story.
cues.zh: 您自己的经历也让我着迷。

cues.en: You're a jet fighter pilot. You've broken a succession of world records.
cues.zh: 您是喷气式战斗机飞行员，还接连打破过多项世界纪录。

cues.en: What motivates you to take on that one extra challenge?
cues.zh: 是什么激励您继续迎接又一次挑战？

cues.en: Well, the invitation to work with a world-class team of engineers—JCB, who are the world leaders in hydrogen internal combustion engine technology,
cues.zh: 首先，是与世界级工程师团队合作的邀请——JCB是氢内燃机技术领域的世界领导者，

cues.en: and Prodrive, and Xtrac, and of course Ricardo, who managed to uprate
cues.zh: 还有Prodrive、Xtrac，当然还有成功提升发动机功率的Ricardo，

cues.en: the—the power rating of these engines by a factor of 11, up to 800 horsepower each.
cues.zh: 他们把这些发动机的——发动机的额定功率提高了11倍，达到每台800马力。

cues.en: Perhaps most importantly, to be able to promote a new kind of race car: hydrogen internal combustion engine racing cars.
cues.zh: 也许最重要的是，能够推广一种新型赛车：氢内燃机赛车。

cues.en: The idea is not new, but the technology to do it safely and effectively is new.
cues.zh: 这个想法并不新鲜，但能够安全、有效实现它的技术是新的。

cues.en: And to be able to promote that as a genuine zero-carbon technology of the future—for all of those reasons, why wouldn't I want to join?
cues.zh: 还能把它推广为未来真正的零碳技术——出于所有这些原因，我为什么不愿加入呢？

cues.en: Andy Green.
cues.zh: 安迪·格林。

cues.en: Anthony Bourdain, the bad-boy American chef, writer, and TV star, became a cult figure.
cues.zh: 美国“坏小子”厨师、作家兼电视明星安东尼·波登成为了一位偶像级人物。

cues.en: But eight years ago, he took his own life at the age of 61.
cues.zh: 但八年前，他在61岁时结束了自己的生命。

cues.en: A new film, Tony, looks at a formative year in the life of the man whose
cues.zh: 新片《Tony》聚焦于他人生中具有塑造作用的一年。

cues.en: book Kitchen Confidential pulled back the curtain on a chaotic, drug-fueled, passionate world of the professional kitchen. Here's some of the trailer.
cues.zh: 他的著作《厨房机密档案》揭开了专业厨房混乱、药物泛滥却又充满激情的世界。下面是预告片片段。

cues.en: I need a job. You worked in a kitchen before? Sorry. Yeah.
cues.zh: 我需要一份工作。你以前在厨房干过吗？抱歉。干过。

cues.en: Let me teach you this. This is how you open an oyster.
cues.zh: 我来教你。牡蛎要这样打开。

cues.en: I had these in France when I was a kid. I said they taste like... the future.
cues.zh: 我小时候在法国吃过这个。我当时说，它们尝起来像……未来。

cues.en: We're going to start with a special. Every Friday, something fancy but not pretentious, something sexy, you know, something only you can make.
cues.zh: 我们先从一道特色菜开始。每周五做点精致但不装腔作势、性感诱人、只有你能做出的东西。

cues.en: What is your name? Anthony Bourdain.
cues.zh: 你叫什么名字？安东尼·波登。

cues.en: Well, Nick Robinson spoke to two of his many fans, Sally Abé, Michelin-starred chef in London,
cues.zh: 尼克·罗宾逊采访了波登的两位忠实粉丝：伦敦米其林星级厨师萨莉·阿贝，

cues.en: and first, Jay Rayner, food critic of the Financial Times newspaper, who also knew him personally.
cues.zh: 以及首先出场的杰伊·雷纳——《金融时报》的美食评论家，他与波登本人也相识。

cues.en: He was very important. I became a restaurant critic after being a general journalist in 1999.
cues.zh: 他非常重要。1999年，我从综合新闻记者转行成为餐厅评论家。

cues.en: Obviously, Kitchen Confidential came out in 2000, and it really was an extraordinary blast of invective, a sort of voice that we hadn't heard around food.
cues.zh: 《厨房机密档案》于2000年出版，它确实像一阵非凡的猛烈抨击，是我们在美食领域从未听过的一种声音。

cues.en: There had been other people who'd written from the other side of the kitchen door before, including George Orwell back in the '30s.
cues.zh: 以前也有人写过厨房门另一边的世界，包括20世纪30年代的乔治·奥威尔。

cues.en: But there was something very kinetic and bullshitty about the way he wrote about that world.
cues.zh: 但他描写那个世界的方式充满动感，也带着一种胡扯式的劲头。

cues.en: And he became the appointed spokesperson for a whole particular culture, and that was something we didn't feel we'd heard before.
cues.zh: 他成了某种独特文化公认的代言人，而这种声音是我们以前从未听到过的。

cues.en: Kinetic and bullshitty is one way of putting it, but it was hyper-masculinity, wasn't it?
cues.zh: “充满动感又爱胡扯”是一种说法，但那其实是一种极端阳刚气质，不是吗？

cues.en: It was aggressive, sometimes childish. That's the really interesting point.
cues.zh: 它很有攻击性，有时也很幼稚。这正是非常值得探讨的一点。

cues.en: We have to assess Anthony Bourdain from the perch of now, and the #MeToo movement and issues of abuse in the kitchen, which he himself acknowledged.
cues.zh: 我们必须站在当下，从#MeToo运动和厨房虐待问题的角度审视安东尼·波登，而这些问题他本人也曾承认。

cues.en: He gave an interview in Slate in 2017 where he recognized that he may have actually validated meatheads
cues.zh: 他在2017年接受《Slate》采访时承认，自己实际上可能为那些头脑简单的莽汉提供了正当性，

cues.en: and not necessarily created a space which was comfortable for women to report the issues they were having.
cues.zh: 也未必创造了一个能让女性安心报告自身遭遇问题的环境。

cues.en: Sally can talk about that far better than I can.
cues.zh: 萨莉比我更有资格谈论这个问题。

cues.en: But I think it's one of the interesting things, that he gave a voice to a particular culture while also licensing it,
cues.zh: 但我认为值得思考的是，他在让某种特定文化发出声音的同时，也认可了这种文化，

cues.en: which may not really have been as great a positive as it seemed at the time.
cues.zh: 这件事或许并不像当时看起来那样积极。

cues.en: Sally, go on then, pick up that thought.
cues.zh: 萨莉，请接着这个话题说下去。

cues.en: Well, you know, I think, as Jay said, we've got to look at it at the time. The book came out over 25 years ago,
cues.zh: 嗯，你知道，我觉得正如杰伊所说，我们必须放在当时的背景下看。这本书出版于25年多以前，

cues.en: and I think if you read a lot of things or looked at any television shows, for example,
cues.zh: 我想，如果你去读当时的许多作品，或看看当时的任何电视节目，

cues.en: that had come out at that time, they're of their time. So I think that needs to be taken into consideration, that times have changed a lot.
cues.zh: 你会发现它们都有时代局限。我们必须考虑这一点，因为时代已经发生了很大变化。

cues.en: But I still think he is the chef's chef, and I still think a lot of chefs view him as a complete hero because he was just being honest, and brutally honest, about
cues.zh: 但我仍认为他是“厨师心目中的厨师”，许多厨师仍把他视为十足的英雄，因为他只是诚实地、甚至残酷地诚实讲述，

cues.en: exactly what it was like to work in a kitchen, and that had never been done before.
cues.zh: 在厨房工作的真实感受，而以前从未有人这样做过。

cues.en: And honesty required saying, did it, Sally, that it did require sometimes—
cues.zh: 萨莉，而诚实是否也意味着必须承认，这种工作有时确实需要——

cues.en: and forgive me, I'm not making a point about you, I should hasten to add—
cues.zh: 请原谅，我得赶紧说明，我不是在影射你——

cues.en: it did require people who were not entirely sane some of the time in order to really drive a kitchen forward.
cues.zh: 有时确实需要一些不完全理智的人，才能真正推动厨房运转。

cues.en: Definitely. You know, I mean, it's still the same now.
cues.zh: 当然。你知道，我是说，现在仍然如此。

cues.en: I think, you know, obviously times are changing.
cues.zh: 我觉得，你知道，时代显然正在变化。

cues.en: Certainly my kitchen is not a toxic, shouty, screamy place to work, but it's still crazy.
cues.zh: 我的厨房当然不是一个充满毒性、吼叫和尖叫的工作场所，但那里仍然很疯狂。

cues.en: You know, it's still high pressure, it's still intense, it still requires this
cues.zh: 你知道，那里仍然压力很大、节奏紧张，仍然需要一套，

cues.en: completely different set of skills to somebody, you know, working nine to five in an office.
cues.zh: 与朝九晚五坐办公室的人截然不同的技能。

cues.en: Like, you have to be a little bit crazy to work in a kitchen. I think it certainly helps.
cues.zh: 比如说，在厨房工作，你得有点疯狂。我觉得这肯定有帮助。

cues.en: Jay, is that what made him a cult hero?
cues.zh: 杰伊，正是这一点让他成了偶像级人物吗？

cues.en: Because he did become, for people who read that book, saw him on TV, more than just a chef they liked, didn't he?
cues.zh: 因为对那些读过他的书、在电视上看过他的人来说，他确实不只是一个受喜爱的厨师，对吧？

cues.en: Yeah, I mean, it was an insight into a particular world.
cues.zh: 是的，我是说，他让人们得以窥见一个独特的世界。

cues.en: The interesting thing about him was that he was not himself, and he always said this, a particularly accomplished chef.
cues.zh: 他有趣的一点在于，他本人并不是——而且他一直这么说——一位特别有成就的厨师。

cues.en: He was not some great gastronomic hero.
cues.zh: 他不是什么伟大的美食英雄。

cues.en: He had an insight into how kitchens worked, and he had a language and a way to write about them.
cues.zh: 他洞悉厨房如何运作，也拥有一套描写厨房的语言和方式。

cues.en: He tried his hand at fiction. He wasn't particularly good at that.
cues.zh: 他尝试过小说创作，但并不特别擅长。

cues.en: But when it came to describing the life of the kitchen, he found a vocabulary and
cues.zh: 但在描写厨房生活时，他找到了一套词汇，

cues.en: a very direct way to talk about it, which did turn him into
cues.zh: 以及一种非常直接的表达方式，这确实让他成为，

cues.en: a bit of a hero. I did a book event with him in 1999.
cues.zh: 某种意义上的英雄。1999年，我曾和他一起参加一场图书活动。

cues.en: Two hundred people, 199 of them were mad acolytes of his.
cues.zh: 现场有200人，其中199人都是他狂热的追随者。

cues.en: And Sally, did you love his writing as well as his cooking?
cues.zh: 萨莉，你喜欢他的写作，也像喜欢他的厨艺一样吗？

cues.en: Oh, absolutely. I think the thing about his writing is that it's so relatable for everybody.
cues.zh: 当然。我觉得他的文字对每个人来说都非常容易产生共鸣。

cues.en: So you don't have to be an—an Oxford University graduate to understand what he's trying to put on paper.
cues.zh: 所以你不必是——是牛津大学毕业生，也能理解他想写在纸上的东西。

cues.en: And I think that's why it spans so many people that love him, because everybody gets it.
cues.zh: 我想这就是为什么喜欢他的人如此广泛，因为每个人都能理解。

cues.en: That was the chef Sally Abé and Jay Rayner.
cues.zh: 以上是厨师萨莉·阿贝和杰伊·雷纳。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 本期节目到此结束。

cues.en: And if you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 你也可以在X平台上搜索BBC World Service找到我们。

cues.en: Use the hashtag #GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 请使用话题标签#GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sister podcast, The Global Story, which goes in-depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 也别忘了我们的姐妹播客《The Global Story》，它会针对一则重大新闻进行超越标题的深入探讨。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Joe McCartney, and the producer was Judy Frankel.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由乔·麦卡特尼完成混音，制片人是朱迪·弗兰克尔。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Nick Miles, and until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是尼克·迈尔斯，下次再会。
